pill.desc: lyophilized powder in a single-dose clear glass vial

clues.kinetics: Given only as an intravenous infusion.
clues.substance: An animal-derived polyclonal preparation supplied as a sterile lyophilized powder for reconstitution in water.
clues.product: Licensed under a BLA as 25 mg single-dose vials, with one dose given on each of several subsequent days.
clues.safety: Contraindicated after allergy to animal proteins or excipients, or with active infections. Urinary tract infection and abdominal pain are the most common reactions.
clues.indication: Prophylaxis and treatment of acute rejection in adult and pediatric patients receiving kidney transplants.
clues.mechanism: Includes polyclonal antibodies against T-cell markers such as CD2, CD3, CD4 and CD8, which clear T cells from the circulation and modulate their activation.

tell: A polyclonal preparation that depletes T cells within a day, and anti-rabbit antibodies develop in 68% of treated patients.
